Fig. 1: Comparison of 3D, 2D, and the proposed LoGo-MR and LoGo3MR frameworks for BC risk prediction. LoGo-MR combines local slice fusion with global MIL-based sequence modeling to capture both short-range anatomical continuity and long-range slice dependencies, while providing interpretable slice-level importance. LoGo3-MR extends this strategy across axial, sagittal, and coronal planes to capture complementary anatomical cues.

Fig. 4: Multi-plane risk localization with LoGo3-MR. For each case, we present: (Left) Slice-level importance weights learned along the axial (Z), coronal (Y), and sagittal (X) planes. (Right) The maximum intensity projection (MIP) view and corresponding high-importance regions onto orthogonal views, illustrating spatially consistent risk-relevant areas localization across planes over time.
